title: 4838: Log warning for duplicate commit IDs in gitGraph
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR adds a warning log when duplicate commit IDs are encountered in gitGraph. Duplicate commit IDs can lead to incorrect or broken rendering, particularly affecting the chronological layout of commits
Resolves #4838

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Describe the way your implementation works or what design decisions you made if applicable.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
**question**: I'm not sure if this test is useful. I believe `cy.log` just logs a message to the console, it doesn't test if anything is logged to the console (correct me if I'm wrong).

**suggestion**: Maybe a better way to write this test would be to put it into the `packages/mermaid/src/diagrams/git/gitGraph.spec.ts` file? Then you can use Vitest mocks: https://vitest.dev/guide/mocking to check if the `.warn` function was called with the given error message?
comments.label_reasoning: The comment questions whether the test actually validates the intended behavior (console warning), suggesting the test is misleading or ineffective in conveying its purpose, and recommends a more meaningful testing approach.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment suggests moving the test to a different file and using Vitest mocks to properly verify the warn function was called, implying a concrete code change.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.label_reasoning: The comment explicitly flags the variable name 'spyOn' as a poor choice and suggests a more descriptive name 'logWarnSpy'.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment suggests renaming the variable and provides a specific code suggestion for the change.
